description: Read Futunn market data, research, account positions, orders, and execution fills.

authorizationOptions.label: Market data
authorizationOptions.description: Read market data, financial research, and content search results.

authorizationOptions.label: Account information
authorizationOptions.description: Read authorized accounts, balances, positions, orders, and execution fills.

steps: Register an OAuth client at https://webapi.futunn.com/oauth2/register using the official getting-started guide.
Include this runtime's callback URL in redirect_uris and set token_endpoint_auth_method to none.
Paste the application's Client ID. Futunn PKCE applications do not require a client secret.
